title: Canonical bounded-flat finite-free Hom model calculation and restriction square
statement: On the small etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], let $\phi:A\to B$ be a commutative ring map, $F_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ the actual derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $H_A,H_B$ the published internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Use the finite-basis evaluation coordinates [def-sf-finite-free-hom-evaluation-coordinates]. For specified $K,N$ and a specified comparison arrow $u:F_TH_A(K,N)\to H_B(F_TK,F_TN)$, define its local finite-free calculation predicate as follows. For every rank $t\ge0$, trivialization $e:K\simeq A_T^t[0]$, bounded flat complex $P$ [def-sf-etale-bounded-flat-complex] and representing isomorphism $e_P:N\simeq QP$, the evaluation map followed by the product of $e_P$ identifies $H_A(K,N)$ with $(QP)^t$. Define the source coordinates by applying $F_T$ to evaluation coordinates, its finite-product comparison, and the product of the canonical scalar representative maps $F_TN\to Q(P\otimes_A B)$. Define the target coordinates by evaluation on the reduced basis, using the canonical scalar unit, followed by the same product of representative maps. Require both coordinate maps to be isomorphisms and $u$ followed by target coordinates to equal source coordinates. Define the restriction compatibility predicate for specified comparison arrows on $T$ and $U\to T$ by requiring the canonical Hom restriction mates to be isomorphisms and the square between restriction of the first arrow and the second arrow to commute, transported by the normalized scalar/pullback isomorphism [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso]. The theorem using these predicates supplies the actual evaluation-transpose arrows [def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow]; these definitions supply no arbitrary replacement for them. The source and target comparison coordinates are morphisms of B-module derived categories, including the rank-zero empty product.
